items.headline: Nvidia's guarantee for OpenAI's Ohio data center lands at $105B, $145B below the figure floated in July
items.note: Nvidia's financing backstop for the 8GW Pike County campus was cut from an earlier-floated $250B (then a reported sub-$120B) to $105B before signing, a concrete scale-back of the circular Nvidia-OpenAI financing web that Fortune frames as a sign of doubt over real chip demand behind the deal.
